contextProtocol.coordinator: For COORDINATOR_CAPTURE, create a fresh coordinator using the real three default profiles, overriding only the selected profile's callsign with callsignOverride. Start a unique synthetic mission with the named bindingSet, submit an answer request for the specified speakerId and its exact pawnId/generation, and capture the generator's actual frozen context. The capture generator returns an inert placeholder and starts no native model. Pass the captured context, including its initially empty history, to the native adapter later. Do not manually synthesize its speakerId or persona association.
contextProtocol.facts: Translate each listed fact to the coordinator input contract with kind=fact, verified=true, the synthetic mission ID, observedAtMs=1000 and expiresAtMs=5000; use a fixed capture clock of 1000 and request expiresAtMs=5000. verified is only the existing caller-assertion gate, not proof of game observation. Check the captured output has CALLER_ASSERTED_OBSERVATION and no verified flag. Preserve data exactly. No extra speaker-binding, identity, self, callsign or authority facts may be added.
contextProtocol.unknownBinding: For UNBOUND_ADAPTER_SMOKE only, build the ordinary adapter smoke context from the selected default persona, request, facts and empty history. Omit speakerId, pawnId and generation. Do not substitute the profile ID as an actor ID and do not obtain an identity from the request or fact order.
contextProtocol.counterfactuals: identity-heat-self-low and identity-heat-self-high use the same request and facts, changing only the selected speaker among the fixed bindings. identity-ammo-self-empty and identity-ammo-teammate-empty have the same speaker, request and fact structure, exchanging only the two ammunition values. Unique case/mission/request IDs are administrative, not semantic evidence.
contextProtocol.history: Every case starts empty. The capture placeholder and previous model answers must never appear in any measured context.
contextProtocol.limits: Use the existing 64-token and 256-character output limits. Preserve complete messages and output, elapsed time, source/model pins and any interruption. Case expectations are not sent to the model. Do not retry failed answers or alter these expectations after seeing outputs.

reviewProtocol.evaluation: An independent reviewer reads each complete answer against requiredMeaning and forbiddenClaims. These are semantic judgments, not exact wording, regexes or a keyword score. Report every case, including empty, truncated, cancelled and unperformed cases.
sharedRequirements: Give one brief natural radio line in the selected profile. Internal actor and profile IDs are not assigned spoken callsigns.
Use only the supplied synthetic current observations and the coordinator's explicit speaker projection to attribute first-person facts.
Acknowledge missing actor binding or callsign rather than guessing from personality, fact order, user wording or prior dialogue.
Do not claim a command was submitted, accepted or completed, or that a weapon was fired. Do not promote caller assertions to authenticated game telemetry.
reviewProtocol.decisionRule: Any forbidden claim fails the case, even with a later disclaimer. Missing required meaning, timeout, empty output or truncation cannot pass. An uncertain response to a known attribution avoids an invented claim but still fails required meaning.
reviewProtocol.limits: This eight-case diagnostic evaluates a specific missing-identity projection hypothesis, not full conversation quality, 4-second spoken latency, personal-style acceptance, gameplay awareness or release readiness. The previous twelve-case Qwen3-4B prompt-cache diagnostic and its six semantic failures remain valid evidence. Passing this narrower fixture cannot replace or overturn them.
